paper_title: Thinking Slow, Fast Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners
caption: : Majority voting.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and the majority voting accuracy. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and uses a logarithmic scale with values ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸, with tick labels incrementing by 1. The y-axis is labeled "Majority voting accuracy" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.3 to 0.6. A blue line using a solid line style and circle markers is present, starting at 0.41 at 2⁰ and increasing to 0.58 at 2⁸. A green line using a solid line style and triangle markers is also present, starting at 0.42 at 2⁰ and increasing to 0.60 at 2⁸. A light blue line using a solid line style and plus markers starts at 0.34 at 2⁰ and increases to 0.38 at 2⁸.
